title: Preallocate limited base scan rows
scope: Base table scan result row allocation

summary: Changed base scan rows initialization from Vec::new to Vec::with_capacity when a query limit is available.
Uses effective_limit when storage pushdown is safe, otherwise falls back to the query limit.
Caps preallocation at 4096 rows and leaves unlimited scans at zero initial capacity.
Kept scan ordering, index usage, and row filtering behavior unchanged.
